newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin's wife leaves hospital, rejoins husband.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin's wife leaves hospital, rejoins husband.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin's wife Naina has left hospital after a kidney operation in late August and is now by her husband's side helping him prepare for heart surgery, a spokesman said on Tuesday.

Yeltsin, hardly seen in public since winning reelection on July 3, is in the Barvikha sanatorium outside Moscow. Doctors say they will operate within two months to improve the blood supply to his heart.
"Naina Iosifovna Yeltsin has left hospital. She is at Barvikha, where Boris Nikolayevich is," Yeltsin spokesman Sergei Yastrzhembsky told a regular briefing.
Naina had her operation on August 24 in Moscow's Central Clinical Hospital, which is where Yeltsin was being treated before he moved to Barvikha earlier this month.
Yastrzhembsky denied a report by Ekho Moskvy radio that Yeltsin's haemoglobin levels were so low that few surgeons would recommend an operation in the foreseeable future.
